local_checks.invariant: A capture thread that reaches board-demo innerHTML is either discarded or limited to the ASCII thread charset, and every thread or project string is passed through esc() before the sole innerHTML write. No URL, referrer, postMessage, or storage source can plant that string into another visitor's session.
local_checks.result: normalizeThread accepts only ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9.-]{0,31}$ and then lowercases, matching Rust normalize_thread for ASCII length, first character, body, and case. A refusal returns null and does not keep the raw token. The only innerHTML sink is root.innerHTML. Thread and project strings traced into HTML go through esc(), which replaces & < > and quotes. The accepted thread charset contains none of those characters. The public page does not seed the draft from the URL, referrer, postMessage, or storage. Self-typed markup stays in the visitor's own page.
